records.name: Coral
records.style: The dolphin reference is STYLE ONLY. Use the same softly shaded 3D low-poly material and crisp geometric details. A rooted peach/pink branching coral colony with visible tiny polyps.
records.motion: Tiny polyps gently extend from the fixed rooted coral branches and then retract. The coral base remains stationary.

records.name: Clam
records.style: The dolphin reference is STYLE ONLY. Use the same softly shaded 3D low-poly material and crisp geometric details. A natural cream-and-lavender clam with two ribbed shell halves joined at their hinge; never a smiling cartoon face.
records.motion: The two hinged shell halves slowly open to reveal the soft mantle, then smoothly close. Both halves stay connected at the hinge in every pose.

records.name: Reef fish
records.style: The dolphin reference is STYLE ONLY. Use the same softly shaded 3D low-poly material and crisp geometric details. One elegant small blue-green reef fish with natural eyes, tail and fins. Side view facing RIGHT.
records.motion: A continuous gentle tail-and-fin swimming cycle, side view facing RIGHT.

fact.en: Tiny animals called polyps live together to make a coral colony.
fact.yue: 好多細細隻嘅珊瑚蟲一齊住，變成一叢珊瑚呀。
fact.cmn: 许多小小的珊瑚虫住在一起，组成一丛珊瑚。

fact.en: My two shells open and close. They help protect my soft body.
fact.yue: 我有兩片殼，會打開同合埋，保護軟軟嘅身體呀。
fact.cmn: 我的两片壳会打开和合上，保护软软的身体。

fact.en: I swim with my fish friends near the coral reef.
fact.yue: 我同小魚朋友喺珊瑚礁附近一齊游水呀。
fact.cmn: 我和小鱼朋友在珊瑚礁附近一起游泳。
